verdict.rationale: Snowflake's documentation describes first-party Snowflake Notebooks in Snowsight: a cell-based environment for Python, SQL and Markdown that works on Snowflake data. Cell-by-cell execution with results to compare covers the core of the story, and Notebooks in Workspaces adds Jupyter compatibility. Inline charting inside notebooks is not explicitly documented; the community comment about visualization refers to Snowsight generally, not notebooks. missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline charts/visualizations within notebook cells, independent hands-on corroboration of the notebook experience.

support.subject: As an analyst, first-party notebooks let me mix SQL and Python against warehouse data, with results and charts inline

citations.quote: Snowflake Notebooks is a unified development interface in Snowsight that offers an interactive, cell-based programming environment for Python, SQL, and Markdown.
Write SQL or Python code and quickly compare results with cell-by-cell development and execution.
you can leverage your Snowflake data to perform exploratory data analysis
Notebooks in Workspaces is the next generation of Snowflake Notebooks, providing Jupyter compatibility and full integration with Workspaces.
